description: This Java source file defines the ComponentConfig class and related inner classes, modeling the configuration of an 'ofbiz-component' element in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading, managing, and retrieving component configuration details, dependencies, resource locations, and associated info objects.

classes.name: ComponentConfig
classes.description: Main class representing the configuration of an OFBiz component, including methods for loading, accessing, and managing component details and dependencies.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing immutable ComponentConfig instances.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ClasspathInfo
classes.description: Models the <classpath> element, representing classpath locations and types.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.EntityResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <entity-resource> element, representing entity resource configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.KeystoreInfo
classes.description: Models the <keystore> element, representing keystore configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ResourceInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for resource-related info objects.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ResourceLoaderInfo
classes.description: Models the <resource-loader> element, representing resource loader configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ServiceResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <service-resource> element, representing service resource configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.TestSuiteInfo
classes.description: Models the <test-suite> element, representing test suite configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.WebappInfo
classes.description: Models the <webapp> element, representing web application configurations.

methods.name: componentExists
methods.description: Checks if a component with the given name exists in the cache.

methods.name: matchingComponentName
methods.description: Creates a predicate to match components by name, allowing null for any.

methods.name: getAllClasspathInfos
methods.description: Returns a list of all classpath info objects from all components.

methods.name: getAllComponents
methods.description: Returns a collection of all cached component configurations.

methods.name: sortDependencies
methods.description: Sorts component configurations based on dependencies, throws exception on cycles or invalid dependencies.

methods.name: getAllConfigurations
methods.description: Returns all container configurations from all components.

methods.name: getAllEntityResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns all entity resource info objects, optionally filtered by type and component name.

methods.name: getAllKeystoreInfos
methods.description: Returns all keystore info objects from all components.

methods.name: getAllServiceResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns all service resource info objects, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getAllTestSuiteInfos
methods.description: Returns all test suite info objects, optionally filtered by component name.

methods.name: getComponentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a component configuration by global name or root location, creating and caching if necessary.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Constructs the full resource location path for a component resource.

methods.name: getKeystoreInfo
methods.description: Finds the first keystore info matching component and keystore name.

methods.name: getRootLocation
methods.description: Returns the root location path of a component by name.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Opens an InputStream for a component resource.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for a component resource.

methods.name: getWebAppInfo
methods.description: Retrieves webapp info matching server name and context root.
